Research 3.4's recommended new language registry (extends the ~20 languages in vendor code-languages.ts with dotfiles, legacy-modes languages, and file-name-based entries like Dockerfile/Makefile), kept separate from the vendor file so the vendored atomic-editor copy stays diff-free against upstream, per FR-MDE-014 AC-8's 'no mode branching inside vendor files' rule applied to the language table as well.

FR-MDE-014's new CodeMirror 6 code-mode component (AC-8: must be a separate component, not a branch inside src/editor/vendor/atomic-editor/AtomicCodeMirrorEditor.tsx). Must expose the same handle shape and mount-time contract as AtomicCodeMirrorEditorHandle / EditorDocumentPanel's editorMountProps (documentId identity, uncontrolled initial body) so EditorDocumentPanel.tsx's branch can swap it in with a one-line change per the research doc's design note.

FR-MDE-019's SVG dual-mode tab (viewer <-> XML source via CodeFileEditor), thin wrapper composing ImageFileViewer + CodeFileEditor with a local view-mode toggle and shared dirty/save state.
